title: 58 MXS Crane rental and operator
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE GLOBAL STRIKE COMMAND.FA9401  377 MSG PK
description_text: 70-Ton Crane rental with a licensed operator. The contractor shall provide all equipment, necessary materials, certified crane operator and rigger to lift the structure. This shall include lifting slings and shackles. This lift will require one (1) 70-ton crane with operator for one day on July 24th, 2026.
